provenance: Function._eval_evalf and evalf_trig had been removed by the V19 core zero-hit prune.
mpf_sin and mpf_cos had been removed by an earlier spent-profile body prune and remained latent until NEXT23.

disposition: V19 remains historically measured but is superseded as a sound current bounded frontier. NEXT23 is spent. V20 restores only the four exposed donor-derived functions and requires a new untouched corpus.
